objective: Complete readablePaths confinement in src/agent-tools.mjs and create test/readable-paths-complete.test.mjs in the same candidate. list_files and search must allow the empty relative root as a traversal base, refuse an out-of-scope non-root base, and filter every walked file with readAdmitted. Direct read remains confined. Preserve unrestricted behavior when readablePaths is empty. The exact source form is: list/search base refusal only when relativePath !== empty-string and !readAdmitted(relativePath); list_files filters walk results with readAdmitted; search continues before reading any file for which readAdmitted(file) is false.
constraints: Test omitted path and explicit dot root traversal.
Test explicit out-of-scope bases return structured refusals without protected names, matching lines, or bytes.
Test unrestricted behavior with no readablePaths.
Do not edit outside the two focus paths.

given: a territory containing public/match.txt and private/secret.txt
testVectors.when: list_files with omitted path and search for match with omitted path execute from the territory root
forbidden: a refusal merely because the traversal base is root

given: the same mixed public and private territory
testVectors.when: list_files and search execute with path dot
then: dot normalizes to the empty relative root

given: one toolset admits directory public and another admits exact file public/a.txt
testVectors.when: list, search, and direct read exercise both toolsets
then: directory admission exposes both public descendants
direct read remains confined by the same admission predicate
forbidden: a sibling or ancestor becoming readable through exact-file admission

testVectors.when: list_files and search are explicitly based at private
then: each returns a structured JSON refusal
the refusal identifies only that the requested base is outside declared readable scope

testVectors.when: list_files, search, and direct read execute
then: legacy unrestricted behavior is preserved for every operation
forbidden: an accidental deny-all interpretation of an empty readablePaths array
